arxiv-2011-05218.title: SeqMobile: An Efficient Sequence-Based Malware Detection System Using RNN on Mobile Devices
arxiv-2011-05218.creator: Ruitao Feng 1 2 3 , Jing Qiang Lim 2 3 , Sen Chen 4 3 , Shang-Wei Lin 3 , and Yang Liu 3
arxiv-2011-05218.description: Abstract With the proliferation of Android malware, the demand for an effective and efficient malware detection system is on the rise. The existing device-end learning based solutions tend to extract limited syntax features, such as permissions and API calls, to meet a certain time constraint of mobile devices.

arxiv-2105-06297.title: Cosmological Evolution Via Interacting/Non-Interacting Holographic Dark Energy Model for Curved FLRW Space-time in Rastall Gravity
arxiv-2105-06297.creator: Rabia Saleem, Shahnila
arxiv-2105-06297.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the phenomenon of cosmic evolution using curved FLRW space-time bounded by apparent horizon with a specific holographic cut-off. To this end, we use the framework of Rastall gravity (RG) and universe is assumed to be consists of interacting/ non-interacting dark energy (DE) and dark matter (DM).

arxiv-2110-14036.title: Fast estimation of ion-pairing for screening electrolytes: A cluster can approximate a bulk liquid
arxiv-2110-14036.creator: Ajay Muralidharan, Arun Yethiraj
arxiv-2110-14036.description: Abstract The propensity for ion-pairing can often dictate the thermodynamic and kinetic properties of electrolyte solutions. Fast and accurate estimates of ion-pairing can thus be extremely valuable for supplementing design and screening efforts for novel electrolytes. Here, we introduce an efficient cluster model to estimate the local ion-pair potential-of-mean-force (PMF) between ionic solutes in electrolytes.

arxiv-2205-12084.title: SOFIA observations of 30 Doradus: II - Magnetic fields and large scale gas kinematics
arxiv-2205-12084.creator: Le Ngoc Tram, Lars Bonne, Yue Hu, Enrique Lopez-Rodriguez, Jordan A. Guerra, Pierre Lesaffre, Antoine Gusdorf, Thiem Hoang, Min-Young Lee, Alex Lazarian, B-G Andersson, Simon Coudé, Archana Soam, William D. Vacca, Hyeseung Lee, Michael Gordon
arxiv-2205-12084.description: Abstract The heart of the Large Magellanic Cloud, 30 Doradus, is a complex region with a clear core-halo structure. Feedback from the stellar cluster R 136 has been shown to be the main source of energy creating multiple pc-scale expanding-shells in the outer region, and carving a nebula core in the proximity of the ionization source.

arxiv-2211-02477.title: SMAuC – The Scientific Multi-Authorship Corpus
arxiv-2211-02477.creator: Janek Bevendorff, Philipp Sauer, Lukas Gienapp, Wolfgang Kircheis, Erik Körner, Benno Stein, Martin Potthast
arxiv-2211-02477.description: Abstract . The rapidly growing volume of scientific publications offers an interesting challenge for research on methods for analyzing the authorship of documents with one or more authors. However, most existing datasets lack scientific documents or the necessary metadata for constructing new experiments and test cases. We introduce SMAuC, a comprehensive, metadata-rich corpus tailored to scientific authorship analysis.

arxiv-2212-11391.title: Local well-posedness of Kolmogorov’s two-equation model of turbulence in fractional Sobolev Spaces
arxiv-2212-11391.creator: Przemysław Kosewski
arxiv-2212-11391.description: Abstract We study Kolmogorov’s two-equation model of turbulence on d − d- dimensional torus. First, the local existence of the solution with the initial data from non-homogeneous fractional Sobolev spaces (Bessel potential spaces) H s H^{s} with s > d 2 s>\frac{d}{2} is proven using energy methods.

arxiv-2302-04269.title: Diagnosing and Rectifying Vision Models using Language
arxiv-2302-04269.creator: Yuhui Zhang, Jeff Z. HaoChen, Shih-Cheng Huang, Kuan-Chieh Wang
arxiv-2302-04269.description: Abstract Recent multi-modal contrastive learning models have demonstrated the ability to learn an embedding space suitable for building strong vision classifiers, by leveraging the rich information in large-scale image-caption datasets. Our work highlights a distinct advantage of this multi-modal embedding space: the ability to diagnose vision classifiers through natural language.

arxiv-2303-03045.title: GROUND STATES AND GIBBS MEASURES OF ISING MODEL WITH COMPETING INTERACTIONS AND AN EXTERNAL FIELD ON A CAYLEY TREE
arxiv-2303-03045.creator: M.M. Rahmatullaev
arxiv-2303-03045.description: Abstract We consider the Ising model with competing interactions and a nonzero external field on the Cayley tree of order two. We describe ground states and verify the Peierls condition for the model. Using a contour argument we show the existence of two different Gibbs measures.

arxiv-2310-06635.title: Can one hear supercontinents in the tides of ocean planets?
arxiv-2310-06635.creator: Pierre Auclair-Desrotour, Mohammad Farhat, Gwenaël Boué, Mickaël Gastineau, Jacques Laskar
arxiv-2310-06635.description: Abstract Context. Recent observations and theoretical progress made about the history of the Earth-Moon system suggest that tidal dissipation in oceans primarily drives the long term evolution of orbital systems hosting ocean planets. Particularly, they emphasise the key role played by the geometry of land-ocean distributions in this mechanism.

arxiv-2402-07991.title: Current status of the light neutralino thermal dark matter in the phenomenological MSSM
arxiv-2402-07991.creator: Rahool Kumar Barman, Genevieve Bélanger, Biplob Bhattacherjee, Rohini Godbole, Rhitaja Sengupta
arxiv-2402-07991.description: Abstract In a previous publication, we studied the parameter space of the phenomenological Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (pMSSM) with a light neutralino thermal dark matter ( M χ ~ 1 0 ≤ M h / 2 M_{\tilde{\chi}_{1}^{0}}\leq M_{h}/2 ) and observed that the recent results from the dark matter and collider experiments put strong constraints on this scenario.

arxiv-2410-15179.title: HPVM-HDC: A Heterogeneous Programming System for Accelerating Hyperdimensional Computing
arxiv-2410-15179.creator: Russel Arbore, Xavier Routh, Abdul Rafae Noor, Akash Kothari, Haichao Yang, Weihong Xu, Sumukh Pinge, Minxuan Zhou, Tajana Rosing, Vikram Adve
arxiv-2410-15179.description: Abstract . Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC), a technique inspired by cognitive models of computation, has been proposed as an efficient and robust alternative basis for machine learning. HDC programs are often manually written in low-level and target specific languages targeting CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs—these codes cannot be easily retargeted onto HDC-specific accelerators.

arxiv-2411-14685.title: Constraining the progenitor of the nearby Type II-P SN 2024ggi with environmental analysis
arxiv-2411-14685.creator: Xinyi Hong, Ning-Chen Sun, Zexi Niu, Junjie Wu, Qiang Xi, Jifeng Liu
arxiv-2411-14685.description: Abstract The progenitors of Type II-P supernovae (SN) have been confirmed to be red supergiants. However, the upper mass limit of the directly probed progenitors is much lower than that predicted by current theories, and the accurate determination of the progenitor masses is key to understand the final fate of massive stars. Located at a distance of only 6.

arxiv-2501-03474.title: Benjamini-Schramm limits of high genus translation surfaces: research announcement
arxiv-2501-03474.creator: Lewis Bowen, Kasra Rafi, Hunter Vallejos
arxiv-2501-03474.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lewis Bowen, Kasra Rafi, Hunter Vallejos. We prove that the sequence of Masur-Smillie-Veech (MSV) distributed random translation surfaces, with area equal to genus, Benjamini-Schramm converges as genus tends to infinity. This means that for any fixed radius r > 0 r>0 , if X g X_{g} is an MSV-distributed random translation surface with area g g and genus g g , and o o is a uniformly random point in X g X_{g} , then the radius- r r neighborhood of o o in

arxiv-2504-18655.title: Effect of kappa-modified polarization force on Jeans instability in nonthermal EiBI-gravitating dust clouds
arxiv-2504-18655.creator: Dipankar Ray, Siddhartha Saikia, Pralay Kumar Karmakar
arxiv-2504-18655.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dipankar Ray, Siddhartha Saikia, Pralay Kumar Karmakar. A semi-analytic model is developed to study the effects of κ \kappa -distributed lighter constituents and the associated κ \kappa -modified polarization force on the classical Jeans instability in dust molecular clouds (DMCs). The constitutive electrons and ions are considered to follow a nonthermal κ \kappa -velocity distribution law, while the constitutive massive dust grains are treated as the EiBI-gravitating fluids. A linearized quadratic dispersion relation is derived using spherical normal mode analysis.

arxiv-2505-21180.title: Latent label distribution grid representation for modeling uncertainty
arxiv-2505-21180.creator: ShuNing Sun, YinSong Xiong, Yu Zhang, Zhuoran Zheng
arxiv-2505-21180.description: Abstract Although L abel D istribution L earning (LDL) has promising representation capabilities for characterizing the polysemy of an instance, the complexity and high cost of the label distribution annotation lead to inexact in the construction of the label space.

arxiv-2506-11760.title: FeNN: A RISC-V vector processor for Spiking Neural Network acceleration This work was funded by EPSRC grants EP/V052241/1 and EP/S030964/1; and the EU’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under Grant Agreement 945539. Hardware was provided by the Xilinx University Program.
arxiv-2506-11760.creator: Zainab Aizaz 1 § , James C. Knight 1 § , and Thomas Nowotny 1
arxiv-2506-11760.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have the potential to drastically reduce the energy requirements of AI systems. However, mainstream accelerators like GPUs and TPUs are designed for the high arithmetic intensity of standard ANNs so are not well-suited to SNN simulation.

arxiv-2507-04785.title: Communication Round and Computation Efficient Exclusive Prefix-Sums Algorithms (for MPI_Exscan )
arxiv-2507-04785.creator: Jesper Larsson Träff
arxiv-2507-04785.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jesper Larsson Träff. Parallel scan primitives compute element-wise inclusive or exclusive prefix sums of input vectors contributed by p p consecutively ranked processors under an associative, binary operator ⊕ \oplus . In message-passing systems with bounded, one-ported communication capabilities, at least ⌈ log 2 ⁡ p ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}p\rceil or ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( p − 1 ) ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}(p-1)\rceil communication rounds are required to perform the scans.

arxiv-2606-15569.creator: Tomoya Wakayama

pmc-11359433.title: Toxicity of Moxifloxacin on the Growth, Photosynthesis, Antioxidant System, and Metabolism of Microcystis aeruginosa at Different Phosphorus Levels
pmc-11359433.creator: Liang Wan, Yan Zhou, Rong Huang, Yiying Jiao, Jian Gao, Samuel Caito
pmc-11359433.description: Moxifloxacin (MOX), a widely used novel antibiotic, may pose ecological risks at its actual environmental concentrations, as has been detected in aquatic systems. However, its ecotoxicity to aquatic organisms and regulatory mechanisms of phosphorus in eutrophic aqueous environments are still limited.

pmc-11506116.title: Clostridial Infections in Cattle: A Comprehensive Review with Emphasis on Current Data Gaps in Brazil
pmc-11506116.creator: Felipe Masiero Salvarani, Eliel Valentin Vieira, Steven Van Winden
pmc-11506116.description: Simple SummaryClostridial infections in cattle are a major veterinary concern in Brazil, significantly impacting the country’s livestock industry. These infections are caused by various Clostridium species, which are anaerobic, spore-forming bacteria capable of producing powerful toxins. The main clostridial diseases affecting cattle in Brazil include botulism, tetanus, blackleg, malignant edema and enterotoxemia.

pmc-11629987.title: The diabetic myocardial transcriptome reveals Erbb3 and Hspa2 as a novel biomarkers of incident heart failure
pmc-11629987.creator: Marcella S Conning-Rowland, Marilena Giannoudi, Michael Drozd, Oliver I Brown, Nadira Y Yuldasheva, Chew W Cheng, Paul J Meakin, Sam Straw, John Gierula, Ramzi A Ajjan, Mark T Kearney, Eylem Levelt, Lee D Roberts, Kathryn J Griffin, Richard M Cubbon
pmc-11629987.description: AimsDiabetes mellitus (DM) increases heart failure incidence and worsens prognosis, but its molecular basis is poorly defined in humans. We aimed to define the diabetic myocardial transcriptome and validate hits in their circulating protein form to define disease mechanisms and biomarkers.

pmc-11669158.title: Engineering Adhesion of the Probiotic Strain Escherichia coli Nissle to the Fungal Pathogen Candida albicans
pmc-11669158.creator: Alexandre Chamas, Carl-Magnus Svensson, Carla Maneira, Marta Sporniak, Marc Thilo Figge, Gerald Lackner
pmc-11669158.description: Engineering live biotherapeutic products against fungal pathogens such as Candida albicans has been suggested as a means to tackle the increasing threat of fungal infections and the development of resistance to classical antifungal treatments. One important challenge in the design of live therapeutics is to control their localization inside the human body.

pmc-11691935.title: A FIRST LOOK AT THE HEALTHY AGING INITIATIVE: YEAR ONE RESULTS
pmc-11691935.creator: Talia Gilfix, Molly Quigley, Heather Andrews, Davide Cappon, Maggie Syme, Alvaro Pascual-Leone
pmc-11691935.description: The Healthy Aging Initiative (HAI) is a Boston-based longitudinal observational study assessing functional ability and well-being in 55+ adults residing in independent-living senior communities. Participants undergo assessments to evaluate modifiable risk factors for disability and dementia: mobility, cognition, strength, functional status, lifestyle factors, and mental wellness. Timely feedback/results are provided to empower meaningful changes.

pmc-12405401.title: Associations between prepartum urine pH and periparturient blood calcium concentrations in multiparous Holstein cows
pmc-12405401.creator: Jesse P. Goff, Pedro Melendez, Julian A. Bartolome, Thomas R. Overton, Brittany M. Leno, Geneva Graef, James K. Drackley, Kristen M. Glosson, Xiangfei Zhang, Stephen J. LeBlanc, Rita Couto-Serrenho, José E. P. Santos, Camilo Lopera, Roney Zimpel, Rachael M. Rodney, Ian J. Lean
pmc-12405401.description: IntroductionMetabolic alkalosis induced by prepartum diet cations impairs Ca homeostasis in the periparturient cow. Adding anions to prepartum diets reduces blood pH improving periparturient Ca homeostasis. Urine pH generally reflects blood pH and is practical to measure on farm. The degree to which urine should be acidified to increase periparturient blood Ca concentration is not well defined.

pmc-12421177.title: Perceived risk of human papillomavirus infection and cervical cancer: a qualitative study among Ethiopian women
pmc-12421177.creator: Tadesse Fikre Lema, Annah Mosalo, Mary Moleki
pmc-12421177.description: ObjectivesThe main objective of this study was to explore and describe perceived risk of women towards Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection and cervical cancer (CC) in Adama, Ethiopia. Perception of women towards CC screening was also investigated.DesignA qualitative exploratory, descriptive and contextual research design was employed. The health belief model (HBM) theoretical framework guided the study.

pmc-12436595.title: Eco-friendly zinc-chitosan/poly(l-lactic acid)/polyurethane nanocomposites for dye removal and antimicrobial wastewater treatment
pmc-12436595.creator: Magda M. Ragab, Amr M. Beltagi, Samia M. Elsigeny, Shaban Y. Shaban
pmc-12436595.description: This research explores the development of sustainable zinc-chitosan/poly(L-lactic acid)/polyurethane (ZnCS/PLA/PU) nanocomposites for the dual-purpose treatment of wastewater by removing Acid Blue 25 dye and inhibiting pathogens. The nanocomposites were synthesized at ZnCS-to-PU ratios of 4:1 (ZCPP41), 1:1 (ZCPP11), and 1:4 (ZCPP14) and feature particle sizes of 191–365 nm and zeta potentials ranging from + 39.1 to -9.7 mV.

pmc-12690939.title: Patient autonomy in inpatient medical rehabilitation in Germany—study protocol of a multicenter cross-sectional study
pmc-12690939.creator: Malte Klemmt, Dagmar Holmer, Tanja Henking, Silke Neuderth
pmc-12690939.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe bioethical principle of respect for patients' autonomy should be implemented in every area of health care. The German rehabilitation system has some characteristics (e.g. the prevalence of inpatient rehabilitation) that make the topic particularly relevant.

pmc-12815862.title: The association between polyphenol consumption and stroke risk factors in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12815862.creator: Sarah N. Alsharif
pmc-12815862.description: IntroductionEating foods rich in polyphenols has been shown in numerous trials to lower the incidence of stroke. The present study aimed to evaluate the relationship between stroke risk variables and the consumption of polyphenols.MethodsAn online questionnaire was used to conduct a cross-sectional study involving 293 healthy persons aged at least 18 years in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-13070211.title: Expanding the Prenatal Phenotypic Spectrum of TRPV6 Variants With Ocular Anomalies
pmc-13070211.creator: Edouard Leyne, Jelena Martinovic, Peter Kamenický, Agnès Linglart, Julien Saada, Alexandra Benachi, Alexandre J Vivanti, Jérôme Bouligand
pmc-13070211.description: Summary What is known?◦Genetic disorders of calcium/phosphate metabolism can cause prenatal bone disease, often leading to postnatal respiratory distress and with patients exhibiting bone improvement with calcium supplementation.What's new?◦We broaden the TRPV6 variant fetal phenotype with bilateral ocular involvement, mirroring postnatal hypocalcemia features.

pmc-13095571.title: Emerging roles of PIWI-interacting RNAs in cancer molecular diagnostics and therapeutics: a molecular biosciences perspective
pmc-13095571.creator: Qianqian Yang, Jingping Wu, Yu Su
pmc-13095571.description: Cancer claims nearly 10 million lives yearly, demanding innovative diagnostics and therapies beyond surgery and chemotherapy’s limitations, such as resistance and toxicity. Next-generation sequencing has unveiled PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs), 26–31 nucleotide small non-coding RNAs, as pivotal regulators in cancer pathogenesis, offering fresh biomarkers and targets from a molecular biosciences lens.

pmc-13240531.title: High SAD PERSONS scale scores are associated with subsequent psychiatric admission after suicide attempts: A single‐center retrospective study
pmc-13240531.creator: Tatsunori Nagamura, Takero Terayama, Kohei Yamada, Hiroyuki Toda, Tetsuro Kiyozumi
pmc-13240531.description: AimThe SAD PERSONS scale (SPS) assesses the risk of future suicide attempts; however, its utility in patients with severe physical injuries is unclear. This study explored the association between high SPS scores and subsequent psychiatric admission (SPA) among patients transported to a tertiary emergency center following suicide attempts.

pmc-13283549.title: Anatomic Risk Factors for Unilateral and Contralateral Pediatric Anterior Cruciate Ligament Tears
pmc-13283549.creator: Akbar Syed, Casey Kuka, Brendon Mitchell, Morgan Swanson, Sulagna Sarkar, Theodore Ganley
pmc-13283549.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Various studies have examined anatomic risk factors for Unilateral ACL tears (U-ACL). Only one study has focused on the notch width index (NWI) in patients with Contralateral ACL tears (C-ACL).Hypothesis:U-ACL and C-ACL will have common anatomic risk factors.Methods:We retrospectively analyzed 297 pediatric patients matched by age, sex, and body mass index (BMI), including 99 with U-ACL, 99 with C-ACL (who had a prior ipsilateral tear), and 99 controls with anterior knee pain.

pmc-13522804.title: Evolution of SPP1+ cavity macrophage-mediated immunotherapy resistance in peritoneal metastasis of colorectal cancer
pmc-13522804.creator: Xiaomeng Dai, Chunyu Lai, Libing Hong, Yuzhi Jin, Jinlin Cheng, Haimeng Yan, Xuqi Sun, Bin Li, Chuan Liu, Hangyu Zhang, Yanwei Lu, Haibo Zhang, Danyang Wang, Peng Zhao, Yu Shi, Weijia Fang, Shan Xin, Xia Yu, Xuanwen Bao
pmc-13522804.description: SummaryThe immunometabolic basis of therapy-resistant colorectal cancer (CRC) peritoneal carcinomatosis with malignant ascites remains poorly defined. Here, we profile ascites immune cells from 20 patients across treatment-naive, chemo/targeted therapy-refractory, and immune checkpoint blockade (ICB)/adoptive T cell therapy (ACT)-resistant CRC. Single-cell RNA sequencing identifies SPP1+ cavity macrophages as drivers of CD8+ T cell dysfunction.

pmc-13573756.title: New York state resistance to federal regression of sexual and reproductive rights
pmc-13573756.creator: Danielle Greene, Diana Romero, Holly Farkas
pmc-13573756.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As anti-rights actors have consolidated political power in the US, restrictions on sexual and reproductive health and rights have expanded through judicial, legislative, legal, and fiscal mechanisms. Danielle Greene and colleagues examine how New York’s experience illustrates both the potential and the limits of state level resistance

For nearly a quarter of a century, anti-rights forces in the US have consolidated national and local power with the goal of undermining sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR).
